## [2.1.1](https://github.com/Overhypedcat/overhypedcat-twitch-patches/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1) (2026-11-01)

### Bug Fixes

* Visible "Blocking ads" label and no 5 second stalls during an ad ([9d1d67f](https://github.com/Overhypedcat/overhypedcat-twitch-patches/commit/9d1d67f3b25b966f07e57370e47b9fd890020c7f))

patches.name: Block ad servers
patches.description: Blocks Twitch's banner, display and feed ads (edge.ads.twitch.tv) and its tracking servers inside the app.

patches.name: Block client-side ads
patches.description: Makes the app treat every ad eligibility check like a Turbo viewer, so it never starts the ads it plays itself (a black screen while their ad server is blocked).

patches.name: Block stream ads
patches.description: Replaces ad-laden live playlists with ad-free ones from other player types, and strips ad segments when no clean playlist exists.

patches.name: Detailed log setting
patches.description: Adds a Detailed log switch to Settings, Preferences. While it is on, a detailed log of the ad blocker and the video player's connections is written to Downloads.
